dt: Next review deadline Feb 1, 2027 (for meetings May-Aug 2027); then May 1, 2027 (meetings Sep-Dec 2027). Apply before the meeting starts.
e: Optica considers requests from organizers of optics and photonics meetings for modest grants that fund student prizes or grants and invited-speaker or attendee participation; it does not fund catering, venues or publications. Individuals cannot apply for their own travel; priority goes to meetings in developing or underrepresented countries and on emerging topics.
n: Optica Global Meeting Grants (support for meeting organizers)
